action_labels.description: Whether the action names are offered as labels.

candidates.description: A shell command that prints the candidates.

free_text.description: Take any words as the target.

leave_mode.description: The reason the action leaves the integration's mode with; needs a `[mode]` table.

listen_for_pick.description: Listen for the pick instead of asking on screen.

miss.description: The action is the miss handler.

mode_entry.description: The action opens the integration's mode.

mode_switch.description: The action switches the session's mode.

no_match.description: What to say when no candidate matches.

silent.description: Run without a spoken or notified result.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds before the action is given up.

wait.description: A built-in condition to wait for after the action: `active_window_is_id`, `active_window_changed`, `window_gone` or `popup_open:<name>`.

wait_hook.description: A hook to wait on after the action.

confirm_labels.description: Action labels that ask before running.

define.description: Named patterns a verb's `match` can use.

fallback.description: Tried only when no other integration offered an option.

force_prefixes.description: Spoken prefixes that force this integration.

help.description: What `help` lists for an action: a hook (`list`), one static row (`id`, `label`) or the candidates.

id.description: The id of a static row; needs `label`.

label.description: The label of a static row.

list.description: A hook that prints the rows; excludes `id` and `label`.

match_ignore_words.description: Words dropped before a target is matched.

alive.description: A command that says whether the mode is still alive.

allows_switches.description: Whether other modes can be entered from this one.

bare_exits.description: Whether a bare `stop` leaves the mode.

default_exits.description: Whether `<mode> stop` and `<mode> off` leave the mode.

ended.description: A command run when the mode ends.

match.description: The pattern that ends the mode.

exit_hint.description: Spoken hint on how to leave.

exit_object.description: The word that follows `stop` or `off` to leave the mode.

exit_phrases.description: Extra spoken phrases that leave the mode.

handle_turn.description: The action that handles each turn.

one_recording.description: Keep one recording open across turns.

open_ended.description: Leaves the mode's time out of the session's.

private.description: Keep the turns out of the logs.

drop.description: Pattern; a turn that matches routes nothing.

keep.description: Pattern; a turn that matches routes as spoken.

prefix.description: Words put before any other turn.

rewrite_hook.description: A hook that rewrites the turn.

wake_listens.description: Kept in session.json; the wake listener no longer reads it.

name.description: Display name; the file stem when absent.

picker.description: How the integration's options are shown: `hints` numbers them over their boxes on screen.

private_labels.description: Keep candidate labels out of the logs.

silent.description: Run without a spoken or notified result.

state_file.description: File under the runtime dir whose `open` flag says the surface is open.

target_match.description: How a spoken target is matched to a candidate.

verbs.description: The phrases the integration takes, tried in order.

requires.description: An integration stem; the verb counts only while that integration is loaded.
